title: Setup: a team record lists Sessions with "Sign out other devices", which signs out the admin's own sessions
body:
Filing gate **③ a task the maintainer set**: objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2188, the maintainer's browser pass of 2026-10-20. Each defect gets its own card, by the maintainer's ruling 「按照按照具体的issue单独提交卡片，不受数量限制。」 (recorded on objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2188, `6283467378`). This is finding **F-15** of track 2 (Setup as the system administrator), by the cloud tester `session_01VuXyJvhGKJy8qeUvhKyxzv`. It was measured on HotCRM `main` `f22dfa52` with `@objectstack/*` 18.0.0-next.5, in Chromium at 1440×900 on a locally booted, seeded install. The evidence is on the branch `claude/qa-setup-pass-2026-10-20` at `ed4f40e42`, which is never merged. Filed by the `repo:hotcrm` seat 2 (`os-support-ai`, session `session_01KqkTQNLcxVc588eZpJmp1r`). ⛔ Not a claim. Grade: triage's.

**Reader (who acts):** objectstack triage routes it.

## The finding, as measured

- **Persona / URL:** dev admin, Teams → a team → Related.
- **Actual:** the team overlay lists *Sessions* (0) with a "Sign out other devices" button; its confirm reads "Sign out of every other device where you're currently logged in?" — it acts on the admin's own sessions, not the team's.
- **Evidence:** [`10-F-teams-related-sessions-signout.png`](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/hotcrm/blob/ed4f40e42b8b6ce059a4e648f25f8f6037ffd9f6/qa/2026-10-20-setup-pass/shots/10-F-teams-related-sessions-signout.png), [`10-people-teams-related.png`](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/hotcrm/blob/ed4f40e42b8b6ce059a4e648f25f8f6037ffd9f6/qa/2026-10-20-setup-pass/shots/10-people-teams-related.png).
- **class: a.** **Reach:** every admin opening a team.
- **Suspected landing:** objectstack `plugin-auth` `sys_team` page layout (related list of `sys_session` carrying its header action).
- **Dedupe words:** team related sessions, sign out other devices on team.

## Seat review

- **Landing (seat review):** `packages/platform-objects`. The `sys_session.active_team_id` lookup gives teams a related list of sessions, because it does not set `relatedList: false`. That list carries the self-scoped header action.

## Dedupe

Method: semantic `search_issues` on objectstack-ai/objectstack and objectstack-ai/objectui, open and closed, using the finding's own dedupe words and a second phrasing; plus a grep of every issue title (objectstack #1–#24751, objectui #7–#13153) listed through the repo-scoped `issues?state=all` endpoint, because the semantic search can miss title words (objectstack#14743).
- 0 hits in objectstack, 0 in objectui. **New.**
